name: Greece

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C) - tourism
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Greece is a Schengen member; the common Schengen fee applies (EUR 90 since 11 June 2024, confirmed by EC Home Affairs and Greek MFA mission pages). Children 6-12 pay EUR 45; under 6 free. Waivers for school pupils, students, researchers and certain other categories.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C) - business
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Same uniform Schengen type C fee; no separate business-visa tariff.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (type A)
fees.applies: nationalities subject to airport transit visa requirement
fees.notes: Same uniform fee as type C under the EU Visa Code.

fees.name: ETIAS travel authorisation (visa-exempt travellers)
fees.applies: visa-exempt nationalities (once ETIAS becomes operational, expected late 2026)
fees.notes: EU-wide, not Greece-specific; fee set at EUR 20 (raised from the originally planned EUR 7). Free for under-18s and over-70s. Not yet in force as of the update date.

fees.name: E-visa
fees.notes: Greece does not operate an e-visa; applications are lodged at consulates or outsourced visa centres.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: No visa-on-arrival regime; visas must be obtained in advance.

reciprocity_variations.note: Reduced fee under EU visa facilitation agreements (EC Home Affairs).
Reduced fee under EU-Cabo Verde visa facilitation agreement.
EU-Russia visa facilitation agreement suspended since September 2022; standard EUR 90 fee applies.
Standard uniform Schengen fee; no reciprocity reduction or surcharge for these nationalities.
Visa-exempt for short stays; will require ETIAS (EUR 20) once operational.

vfs.operator: VFS Global (many corridors); Global Visa Center World (GVCW) handles Greece in India and some other countries
vfs.service_fee: approx USD 22-45 equivalent (e.g. AED 88 in UAE, USD 22 in Lebanon, USD 32-45 in USA)
vfs.note: Service/logistics fee varies by centre and country and is charged on top of the EUR 90 visa fee; verify on the local visa.vfsglobal.com Greece page. In India Greece uses GVCW, not VFS.

free_visa_notes: Visa fee waived for children under 6, school pupils/students/postgraduates and accompanying teachers on study trips, researchers, and representatives of non-profit organisations aged 25 or under attending events (EU Visa Code categories).
